termsAndConditions.en: Does this replace my current package? Yes, this will replace your current package. How much will I be charged? On your next bill, you'll see a credit for the package that you're disconnecting today because you paid in advance. You'll also see a partial charge that covers the new package starting today, and the regular monthly charge that we bill in advance for the following month. How long does activation take? 5 minutes.
